name: Kelders van Geheime
description: Kelders van Geheime (Cellars of Secrets) is a South African, Afrikaans-language telenovela based on the wheeling's and dealings of the community that lives on Soebatskloof (a wine farm in the Cape). The series focuses on three families: the Abrahams, Syster and Marais households. These families will have to stand together, agree (or agree to disagree), and work together to earn their bread and butter – and a glass of wine.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Soebatskloof is getting ready to celebrate another decade of Marais' on this gorgeous wine farm in the Cape Winelands. Meet the Marais family and their staff, preparing a long table for the celebrations. Is there more than meets the eye?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Major announcements during the long table celebration of Soebatskloof throw the world on its head, CJ and Gabby flirt with danger.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hermien struggles to come to terms with Charl Snr's diagnosis. Sandy is over the moon while planning the wedding, but Shireen and Debbie-Lee are less than impressed.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sandy is taking the wedding plans too seriously and rubs Nenna the wrong way. Armand and Jason are worried about the future of their work.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After a night of passion, Veronique is almost caught out. Junior is negotiating with a real estate agent about selling the farm.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The workers are very upset when they are informed of the possible sale of the wine farm. They decide on a course of action. Edmund is starting to see that his world is not as safe or simple as he had hoped.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Nenna is upset that everyone is keeping vital information from her and Edmund's plans with Shireen are a shock to Sandy and Joey.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sandy threatens to boycott the wedding, Hermien falls deeper into an emotional well, Veronique hears something she shouldn't, Debbie-Lee is frustrated with Phillip and a great tragedy befalls the farm.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Soebatskloof is in shock after the freak accident. Even Veronique is sad. Staff and family members watch while the police and paramedics do their work.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The farm is in mourning. Tjoppie tries to motivate and reassure the workers, and Veronique's ambition is evident. Junior arrives from London and feels out of place following his previous visit and argument with Charl Snr.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The people of Soebatskloof are reeling in the aftermath of Charl Snr's tragic accident. Hermien waits on tender hooks to get the go ahead to put her beloved husband to rest.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Junior has the whole family up in arms with his selfish attitude. Tension runs high with the funeral looming and uncertainty about the new will. Who will carry on the Marais legacy?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The Marais family is concerned about Tjoppie's health. Junior is determined to challenge the will, while Veronique attempts to influence Tjoppie. Nenna and Joey discover who benefits from Charl Snr's estate.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The battle lines are drawn as all the players show their hand after the reading of Charl Snr's will. Veronique commissions Tjoppie to do damage control, while Edmund tries to recover from the shock of inheriting the farm.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Charl Snr's funeral is challenged by the many secrets that have been buried over time on Soebatskloof. The emotions run high in the aftermath of the reading of the will.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The pressure mounts on Veronique and Junior after Hermien saw them together in a very compromised position. Both try and find out why Hermien chooses not to confront them about what she had seen.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Junior and Veronique concoct a plan to keep their affair under wraps. CJ is sick and tired of sharing Gabby with Armand. Edmund makes a decision about his future. An unexpected visitor arrives.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Soebatskloof is like a ticking time bomb. Anger, resentment, and envy reign supreme. Not to mention lust and deceit. What will finally trigger an explosion?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The Marais sons and grandsons face another difficult emotional hurdle. Can Du Toit's mother help heal the rift between him and Annette? Will Veronique and Junior manage to save their inheritance? Or is Tjoppie's approach the best solution?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Veronique and Junior finally put the ball in motion to prove that Charl Snr was not of sane mind when changing his will. The gloves come off as the Marais children are challenged to take sides.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Junior proves Veronique wrong when he calls Sandy and Debbie-Lee on the red carpet. Shireen fights against the green eye monster, while Armand loses all reason after seeing CJ kiss Gabby.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee tells Tjoppie about Veronique and Junior's devious plan. CJ is determined to help Gabby. Annette is re-evaluating her life choices. Will anyone be able to put a stop to Junior's plans?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The barely contained calm on Soebatskloof is under threat again. Will Hermien be able to protect her family from ghosts of the past? Will Annette stand her ground for once?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: CJ still feels responsible for Gabby and is upset with Marco for not wanting to participate in his plan. Edmund learns that Annette is considering IVF and makes a startling discovery about Shireen.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Edmund struggles to come to terms with Shireen's decision to put her career before children. Du Toit remains incapable of finding the way to Annette's heart.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Hermien is upset to hear that Junior has gone against her instruction to keep Octavia from the property. Annette tries to figure out why she is dragging her heels to make an appointment with the fertility specialist

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Hermien has her hands full knowing that Octavia is secretly meeting with Junior. Will she be capable of standing up to the bullish Junior if he ignores her order that Octavia is not to be allowed on the farm?

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Octavia tells a different story from the one that has been told to Annette and Junior all of these years. CJ discovers something unexpected in Junior's car. Hermien begs Octavia to let sleeping dogs lie and Octavia threatens Nenna.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Octavia has a suggestion that poses a greater danger for Nenna and Veronique and Octavia's claws come out. Annette and Edmund are like moths to a flame and Armand does not let grass grow under his feet.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Edmund and Annette are both filled with guilt while Shireen has hope for her and Edmund. Veronique is disappointed in her sons and Gabby tells CJ the truth.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Octavia shares her version of what happened in the past. CJ says things are finally done between him and Gabby and Armand asks Tjoppie for a favour.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Soebatskloof is buzzing after Octavia's claim that she bought some of the farm's land from Marcel. Veronique has to decide whose side she will be taking as the war of ownership ensues.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Octavia, once again, has an Ace up her sleeve which she plays to rattle the Marais clan. Annette puts in a last desperate effort to get Du Toit to allow her to stay on Soebatskloof which sends their relationship into uncharted territory.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Edmund and Annette are at a crossroads. Gabby's lies finally catch up with her. The people of Soebatskloof realise that nothing will ever be the same again as Octavia stakes her claim.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Octavia is making her presence felt and makes no bones about it that she's the new boss. While Gabby's life is falling apart, both Debbie-Lee and Shireen seem determined to take charge of their lives.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: CJ overhears a shocking conversation. Octavia's gift to CJ infuriates Veronique. Debbie-Lee is set on going to France. Hermien begs Annette not to attend Octavia's dinner.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Octavia surprises everybody with an unexpected announcement. CJ's suspicions are confirmed. Edmund tells Annette she doesn't have to return to Australia. Veronique receives incriminating pictures.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Will CJ keep Veronique's secret and is there anyone on her side? Annette makes a shocking discovery and Marco meets the mysterious guy he was talking to online.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Edmund is put under incredible pressure when Junior plays his trump card and Veronique is once again plotting. Jason and Marco experience conflict and Shireen worries about Debbie-Lee.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: As the pressure on the Marais household increases, Hermien begins to sleepwalk again and some secrets about the past are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Edmund is on high alert as he realises that Octavia and Junior will push through with their threat. Debbie-Lee asks Phillip to help her get the money for the Culinary course.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Marco and Jason desperately try to prevent CJ from going off the rails. While Edmund has additional threats to worry about besides Octavia and Junior.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Joey's granddaughters cause him sleepless nights and he and Nenna plan an intervention. While Tjoppie struggles to process the truth about his biological father.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Tjoppie tells Veronique about Hermien's confession. Sandy accuses Debbie-Lee of having an affair. While, Edmund finds an unsuspected visitor in his bedroom.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Joey sees a scantily dressed Annette leaving Edmund's house. Sandy urges Debbie-Lee to reach out to Phillip. Hermien receives a threatening note and Shireen is shocked to hear about Edmund's night visitor.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Edmund tells Shireen the half-truth and Tjoppie struggles with the shocking news of Charl Snr. Mercy shares her secret and Shireen confronts Annette.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Veronique plots behind Hermien's back. Shireen tells Debbie-Lee what happened with Annette and Edmund. Veronique humiliates Debbie-Lee and Hermien needs medical attention.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Veronique's enjoyment in blackmailing Hermien is short lived. Annette tries to forget about her desire for Edmund. While Shireen struggles to be in Annette's presence.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Veronique cleverly plays her hand to force Hermien into telling the truth. The news of Shireen's behaviour, the day before, travels and pushes Nenna to take matters in hand.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Annette struggles to process a shocking revelation. Hermien enlists Rijk's help when the walls start closing in. Mercy's 21st celebration is off to a good start.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Hermien takes a break from her family and Soebatskloof. Mercy's 21st is a roaring success. But when things seem too good to be true, they usually are.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Octavia is elated about Hermien leaving. Veronique finds out who spiked the punch at the party and someone gets arrested. Veronique asks Elroy to put her plan in motion.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: A blast from the past arrives at Soebatskloof and leaves everyone in a state of shock. This could change everything...

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Marcel's arrival has the entire Marais family on their toes. Joey and Octavia are at war with one another, while Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie share an uncomfortable moment.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee and Shireen are also at war, Phillip thinks his relationship is on the rocks, Edmund prepares for the worst and Veronique must act quickly, before the DNA test is done.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Marcel becomes used to living in luxury and enjoys the perks of freeloading. Debbie-Lee feels awkward after dreaming of kissing Tjoppie. Junior demands to know why Octavia changed their game-plan.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Veronique succeeds with her plan to get Soebatskloof back as her son's heritage. Phillip's jealousy gets the better of him when Debbie-Lee chooses her cooking class over him.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Panic and concern reign when Sandy discovers that Debbie-Lee is missing. Nenna's shocking confession about what happened to Marcel 30 years ago, takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Veronique's master plan with "Marcel", is not panning out the way she planned. Edmund drops a bomb that puts Shireen in a spin. The Sisters face yet another crisis.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Will Annette reveal anything as the kitchen tea and bachelor party draws closer? And how will Veronique stop "Marcel" from accepting Junior's offer?

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee have a blast while cooking together. Will Annette and Edmund lie or tell the truth when Shireen confronts them?

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The entire Marais household is in chaos when Veronique goes missing and Annette wants to share a secret. Debbie-Lee's guilt is eating her up, while Phillip makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Edmund and Shireen prepare for their wedding. Hermien is back on the farm. Nenna and Sandy are at war with one another while, Veronique puts Junior on his place.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Annette holds Shireen's happiness in the palm of her hand as the congregation waits to hear what her objection is. Hermien must find the right time to speak to Annette about what happened on the night Charl Senior passed.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: After the wedding at Soebatskloof, more drama ensues. Joey tries to pluck up the courage to tell Nema that she holds a special place in his heart. And the press get wind of Du Toit's injury.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Du Toit's arrival creates chaos, as the police and workers struggle to control the media. Du Toit drops a couple of bombs on Annette and the Marais family makes an unexpected appearance.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Du Toit's father makes decisions about where he'll stay during his recovery. Veronique reminds Annette of the promise she made her unborn child. While CJ finds a way to cash in on the family's bad luck.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Du Toit makes life difficult for Annette. Junior intervenes when Du Toit's overbearing father threatens CJ, while Veronique sees this as a sign that things between them are on the mend.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Its clear that Lynn and Francois live separate lives. Tjoppie admits why his marriage is in trouble. Du Toit receives bad news from the doctor, while Annette drops a bombshell.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Du Toit's world is shaken when Annette tells him that she's pregnant with another man's child. Nenna and Joey are left speechless when the phone scamster shows up at Nenna's doorstep.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Du Toit oversteps the boundary when he threatens Annette. Tjoppie realises that keeping his promise to Veronique won't be easy. Joey struggles to accept Charl Senior's generous gift.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Du Toit doesn't appear to be the only one moving in at Soebatskloof. Debbie-Lee deals with her own love problems by focusing on her mother's. The newlyweds return home.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Lynn takes over the running of the Marais household. Mercy realises that she needs Sandy's approval to find a suitable candidate to date. Edmund and Shireens's return tares open old wounds.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Du Toit struggles to cope with his physical and emotional problems. Is Shireen's dream to start her own practice just that - a dream?

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Shireen embarks on a journey to revamp the practice, thanks to Joey's generous donation. Annette feels cornered after the doctor calls a family meeting to discuss Du Toit's progress.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Du Toit's lifeless body is discovered at Soebatskloof. Will his cry for help wake his parents to his plight? Will Dewald and Sandy continue their fake date despite the horror that occurred?

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee doesn't hide her unhappiness anymore. Du Toit's parents struggle to deal with his situation. Dewald and Sandy decide to go on a real date.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Du Toit battles to cope with his new reality. Shireen and Debbie-Lee make peace. The unlikely connection between Sandy and Dewald takes a serious knock.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Annette makes a decision about Du Toit. Dewald explains the nature of his relationship with Kietie to Sandy. While preparations are in full swing for the practice's opening.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Shireen's big day finally arrives. Sandy plans an elaborate outfit while doing her best to ignore Dewald. Is Annette's plan to care for Du Toit best for him after his attempted suicide?

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Veronique realises that Octavia has a few secrets in the closet, which prompts her to investigate her past. Annette takes strain while on suicide watch and Kietie pays Sandy an unexpected visit.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Annette starts Du Toit's journey to recovery with him. Veronique puts her diabolical plan into action. Dewald tries again with Sandy, but gets cut off firmly.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Veronique's erratic behaviour becomes worrisome. Du Toit faces his new reality with Annette's support. Sandy is convinced that love is burning bright between Debbie-Lee and Phillip.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Veronique is admitted to the Aandblom Clinic. Du Toit apologizes to Annette. Sandy is shocked to learn that Debbie-Lee and Phillip did not make up as she thought.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Veronique pulls out all the stops when she realises that Dr Pienaar is too busy to consult with her. Debbie-Lee refuses to divulge the name of the mysterious man she's hanging out with.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Veronique’s plans could be thwarted by Octavia, and Tjoppie’s jealousy is caused by love.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee’s lover gets a lot of attention, and pain makes Annette expect the worst.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Annette’s plans for her and her baby fall apart completely when Shireen discovers that she is pregnant - and questions around paternity will change the future for a few people forever. Octavia shows up at Aandblom Clinic, and delivers an opinion on the institution’s newest patient that the doctor takes very seriously. Veronique’s day doesn’t go according to plan. Phillip meets Debbie-Lee’s lover – and receives a warning.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Edmund’s whole world comes to standstill when he eventually hears everything that has been hidden from him. Tjoppie cannot contain his jealousy anymore, and has a lot to say when he catches Debbie-Lee red-handed. Debbie-Lee unknowingly gives in to a red flag. Veronique’s plans take an unexpected turn when she is bound to her circumstances.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Edmund and Shireen struggle to agree on how to take on the future. Veronique realises that, for the first time in a long while, her future - and her survival! - is in someone else’s hands, and Dr Pienaar is not a man that will allow anyone to mess with him. Tjoppie does his best to concoct a plan that will focus Debbie-Lee’s attention on her biggest passion – and away from what he thinks should be a footnote in her life. Joey needs to decide whether or not he will trust his gut regarding Debbie-Lee’s new love.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Edmund is livid when he discovers that Annette and Du Toit decided to simply disappear without telling anyone about their plans. Edmund’s complicated emotions hurt Shireen when she becomes the target of his inner turmoil. Veronique can, eventually, listen to what she so desperately wanted to find – without having to be worried about her own safety. Tjoppie’s plan for Debbie-Lee doesn’t exactly go according to plan.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Shireen makes a drastic decision after she has had enough of Edmund’s emotional behavior – and her decision stuns Edmund. Jason is not entirely sure whether he will be telling his dad who he'll be taking to the matric farewell. The puzzle pieces are falling into place for Veronique and she decides to show Octavia her trump card – as well as what it will cost Octavia to make the trump card disappear.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Hermien is back in full force on Soebatskloof, and the first thing she does it to put Octavia in her place. Marco thinks he might have a solution to Jason’s dilemma, but CJ’s plans for a date for the matric farewell don't work out the way that he wants them to. Veronique finds out about Debbie-Lee’s cooking course – and her newest love interest. Octavia makes a call to London – and then makes another shocking announcement.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Hermien shares a few words of wisdom with Edmund, while Shireen and Annette have the same type of problems. Phillip offers to make a very insecure Mercy a dress for the matric farewell. Junior receives some very upsetting news, while Veronique is shocked to her core when a ghost from the past appears to her in broad daylight. Shireen makes a decision regarding her marriage.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: It is very clear that Hermien and Octavia do not get along, especially when Octavia tries to make Hermien feel guilty about not being there for Annette in the recent past. Edmund tries his best to repair what he has broken, but in the process he needs to fill Nenna in on what has been going on. Veronique's solution for her problem causes more chaos when the lives of CJ and Marco are threatened. The matric farewell is stirring up a lot of emotions for Mercy, and she comes to a decision about what she wants to do next in her life.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Veronique gives Elroy an assignment that will shift their focus to Soebatskloof - to ensure that the cellar is placed under pressure. Octavia’s reaction to Junior’s news is not what one would expect, while Hermien’s motherly instinct kicks into high gear. Shireen isn’t completely sure about what she should do next, and she takes Alison into her confidence. Veronique takes Mercy to task concerning CJ.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: There are huge problems on Soebatskloof when Edmund finds out that the power outages could last up to two weeks - but it is not just the power cables that are causing problems for him. Junior has a tough time as the new chapter in his life starts – and it isn’t just because Octavia who can’t stand to be around him. Mercy is not impressed by Jason’s plans for the future, and Phillip causes concern for Mercy regarding her dress when feathers give Phillip inspiration.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Phillip eventually shows Mercy her matric farewell dress, while Edmund does everything in his power to solve the problems that are slowly killing Soebatskloof. Veronique realises that her plans will not just break Edmund. Sandy doesn’t handle Junior’s news very well, while Hermien shows up to support him. Shireen words her fears – and expresses them towards Alison. Jason wants to work on his relationship with Spook.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Edmund realises that Soebatskloof has bigger problems than what he imagined. Junior and Octavia have a huge falling out – and she makes a decision that has a bigger affect on Junior than what he would like to acknowledge. At long last the matric farewell is taking place, and everyone on Soebatskloof is excited for the matriculants and their partners to celebrate this big night. Veronique discovers something about Elroy, and decides to confront him about it – but, unfortunately, they are not alone during their standoff.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: The partygoers are blissfully unaware of the dark cloud forming over Soebatskloof  - until they hear the sirens. Veronique does what any mother would do: she takes charge of CJ’s future – she needs to find out if any words were spoken that could contradict her plan. Spook arrests the guilty party, while everyone else from Soebatskloof congregates at the hospital to hear the latest developments.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: CJ has nightmares, and he struggles to make peace with his actions and his conscience. Jason thinks something is wrong with CJ. Hermien and Octavia are trying to call each other out on who is really there for Junior, while Junior’s attention needs to be refocused during his therapy. There is good and bad news from the hospital, and everyone is holding thumbs for the best outcome. Elroy’s loyalty is clearly not with Veronique, and Veronique has to dig deep to find words of encouragement that will inspire CJ…

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: A waterpipe bursts and Soebatskloof also now has to deal with a water crisis on top of the ongoing power outage. CJ doesn’t want to be friends with Jason anymore - and then does the unthinkable. Junior is deeply disappointed in Octavia, and makes a decision regarding her place in his life. Veronique introduces Edmund to a potential investor: Anton Havenga.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: The news from the hospital touches every inhabitant of Soebatskloof. Hermien finds Junior on the floor and Joey comes to the rescue – and later on Tjoppie hears what is really going on. Edmund eventually meets Anton, and is less stressed when it seems that Anton and Senior knew each other. CJ has a panic attack when Mercy’s phone starts to ring.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: The people of Soebatskloof are struggling to make peace with what has happened: Phillip, Jason, and Armand struggle the most. CJ’s guilty feelings unsettle Veronique and Tjoppie. Edmund is stressed when he can’t get hold of Anton. Debbie-Lee has to defend Elroy’s strange behavior. Veronique and Anton’s relationship sours because of his advice on how to deal with Edmund.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: It is time to say goodbye during the memorial service, but CJ refuses to go. Junior is starting to rely on Hermien for support - a lot. Hermien speaks to Shireen about Junior, and they both agree on what they think Junior needs. Jason makes his heartfelt words count, while Elroy has prepared a beautiful story on why he will be absent from the memorial service.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: The focus drastically centres on Tjoppie in the aftermath of CJ’s words. A visibly livid Tjoppie wants to right all the wrongs, and confronts Veronique. Debbie-Lee is very concerned about Tjoppie when he cries in her arms before he leaves for the police station. Tjoppie wants to speak to Bismarck, and CJ wants to say ‘bon voyage’ to his life on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Veronique and CJ are extremely worried that Tjoppie might do something foolish after he finds out the complete truth regarding Mercy - and CJ makes a decision about what he should do next in life.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Tjoppie tries his best to get through to CJ and is shocked to realize that there are a lot of things that have been hidden from him. Anton ensures that he starts entrenching himself into Edmund’s life. Sandy wants to have a serious talk with Elroy - and she has a plan to ensure that Debbie-Lee doesn’t have to make a choice between her relationship and her family. Veronique forms an idea on how to keep Elroy under her spell when she sees something that she shouldn’t.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Phillip and Allison’s first meeting is a bit uncomfortable. Edmund receives a message that doesn’t make sense to him. Junior might not be ready for the road ahead, and Sandy and Joey are very concerned about Debbie-Lee’s relationship. Veronique gives her henchman a deadly task, and Debbie-Lee is not a fan of cheap perfume.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee wants to keep the previous night’s incident to Captain Spook. CJ’s guilt takes center stage - and leads him to want more than just a tipple. Veronique receives an unexpected guest. Allistair’s idea gets Edmund very excited - and Edmund thinks they have to involve Hermien. Dewald starts to woo Sandy again.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Tjoppie’s plan to help CJ involves letters. Debbie-Lee makes a shocking discovery regarding Elroy after she opens her heart completely to him. Allison officially begins to work as Junior’s caretaker. Dewald turns on the charm to get another date with Sandy. Veronique convinces Edmund to have her take a look at the farm’s books.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Edmund is very impressed with Veronique’s plan - so much so that he promises to talk to Dewald and Rijk about getting her access to the farm’s accounts. Veronique is shocked by Allistair’s new plan, as it involves Hermien. CJ and Tjoppie return to Soebatskloof. Debbie-Lee makes a decision regarding Elroy after she has spoken to Shireen.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Kietie’s antics take Dewald and Sandy to the hospital, and it is very clear that Kittie will do anything to ensure she is the only woman in Dewald’s life. An unknown person asks questions about Mercy - and Jason and Marco are shocked when they find out who it is. Edmund’s trust in Anton is wavering, and he words it to Shireen. Allison asks the family to reach out to Junior.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Marco thinks Grace is asking too many questions. Dewald asks Sandy a big question - and then Sandy meets Fransie for the first time. Edmund discusses his concerns regarding Anton with Dewald, and Dewald promises to do his homework on Anton Havenga. Veronique is not happy about Allison moving closer to Junior, and she observes how Anton is making an impression on Hermien.

Junior asks Nenna to try and get through to Allison.
