Brenda’s heart is put to the test when it comes to Joyce and CJ - and a special gesture from him only increases the pressure.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Annette brings more groceries for the Viljoens, while the tension between Tjoppie and Warren places Hermien in a very difficult situation. Nenna and Sandy try to come up with a plan to restore harmony on the farm - but it is no easy task. CJ and Brenda take a huge step in their relationship - that surprises everyone! - and causes a lot of tongues to wag!

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Gabby’s mother, Esther, appears unexpectedly on the farm - and she is not on her own! Surina clearly has a plan of her own that she is executing with precision. Tjoppie finds unexpected support in Marco, while the changes on the farm also bring new challenges as a consequence. Warren’s position as winemaker gets more significance, while Joey carries a difficult task on his shoulders. Veronique feels betrayed when she discovers that Joyce knew about a secret relationship.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Esther turns to Veronique for help. Annette discharges herself from the hospital, and ends up in front of Surina and Lallie’s door. Warren has an important announcement: Napoleon is getting promoted - and realises that Debbie-Lee could become a problem for him. Junior advises Tjoppie that the rift between him and Hermien shouldn’t sour their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Lallie feels left out when Surina again convinces Annette to go shopping, but a secret interest is generated by a chance meeting. Veronique is furious when she discovers what she will receive from the divorce. Warren is invited to dinner by the Systers, and Sandy is deeply shocked when a secret is also dished up.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: In the blink of an eye Veronique becomes a grandmother. Hermien is caught off guard when Annette drops by - and she isn’t alone. An accident demands Warren’s attention and Shireen’s knowledge to work together - and it brings a new dynamic between them. CJ and Brenda make plans for their future on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Hermien pays a visit to the Viljoens, and Annette is shocked to realise that more people know about her secret than what she previously assumed. Surina encourages Annette to stand up for herself. Veronique has a new target in sight, and Tjoppie realises what Warren’s next task at hand is. The conflict between Tjoppie and his sons is draining Debbie-Lee.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: CJ shocks the family with a major revelation, while Veronique arrives unexpectedly on Soebatskloof. Annette arrives on the farm making a bold demand, while Lallie warns her to be cautious. Warren tries to make a good impression with special guests on the farm, while Debbie-Lee sets new boundaries with Tjoppie.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Annette keeps a close eye on Surina, and turns to Rikus for advice. Veronique has a very good reason as to why she's settling into the Marais house - and this causes suspicion with Hermien. Junior is jealous about Tjoppie’s new role in CJ’s life - and CJ is forced to take his role more seriously. Veronique tries to scare Brenda - and makes a demand of her own.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Veronique tries to persuade CJ and Joyce of her point of view concerning Brenda, while Joyce starts to wonder if she is also seeing ghosts. Debbie-Lee’s authority is challenged by Vincheko’s criticism, and she sets new boundaries with Warren. Annette becomes aware of a strange interaction between Lallie and Surina.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Hermien pleads with Annette to return to Soebatskloof. Joey struggles with guilt concerning his past, and Warren takes responsibility for his actions during a conversation with Debbie-Lee. CJ asks Brenda for forgiveness - and pleads for a second chance. Tjoppie offers Debbie-Lee encouragement when she begins to doubt her capabilities.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Hermien is surprised by a threat from Surina, while Joey is forced to make some difficult decisions. Junior hatches his own plans to protect CJ, and Tjoppie arranges an unexpected meeting with Brenda’s family. Meanwhile, Debbie-Lee refuses Warren’s offer of extra help for the restaurant, and CJ continues to struggle with the challenges of his new role as a father.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee takes responsibility for the disaster in the kitchen and Hermien faces a difficult choice when a new demand puts her family under pressure. Tjoppie plans a party for Brenda and CJ’s families to get to know one another better - and Veronique needs to make plans to save herself. Brenda urges CJ to build a stronger bond with Haley, while Lallie crosses paths with someone who stirs her jealousy.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Surina’s demands make Nenna worry about Joey. Annette’s world is shaken and stirred with the truth. Tjoppie and Junior’s plans for CJ and Brenda leads to tension between the two families. Debbie-Lee’s decision leaves Sandy in a predicatment, and Warren faces a shocking demand. Junior and CJ clash over their different perspectives of the future - and a returning face in Bergvallei promises to turn everything upside down.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Annette’s faith in Surina falters when she sees how Surina acts out regarding a sensitive subject. The festivities on Soebatskloof are short lived when Joyce and Gershwin arrive. Warren gives Debbie-Lee an almost impossible task to execute.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Joey is retrenched with immediate effect, and a heavy confrontation regarding the situation leads to a passionate liplock. Surina is caught off guard when Annette arrives on Gelatenheid with Du Toit - and the fight that breaks out leaves Surina seeing red. Tjoppie feels betrayed: he is under the impression that the Solomons devised this humiliation. CJ reconsiders his future on the farm - and he holds Haley for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Lallie’s loyalties are tested when she accidentally overhears details of Surina’s plans for revenge. Peace and reconciliation are short lived in the Marais household when the family is attacked in the study, right before Hermien is ready to share a big secret with them. Napoleon shares his concerns with Warren, while Warren’s answers do not qualm his fears. CJ’s plan to protect his family is dependent on Nenna and Joey’s answer.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Chaos erupts in the Marais mansion when a night of revelations takes a dark turn. Hermien wants to play open cards regarding Annette, but Surina has ideas of her own. Annette and Du Toit make a shocking discovery at Gelatenheid, and then they have to make haste to curb the dark dealings on Soebatskloof. Eventually the real truth is revealed as Surina’s mask slips off...

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Annette and Lallie make a decision to protect Soebatskloof, while Tjoppie, Marco, Junior and Hermien make a decision to protect Annette. Everything becomes too much for Debbie-Lee when another kitchen worker resigns - and blames her for everything. When she reaches breaking point, Tjoppie is there to comfort her - but the moment turns into something else entirely! Brenda and CJ’s marriage is already cracking under the weight of expectations.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Hermien’s conscience chases her, and she needs to find the right words to talk to Annette. Lallie decides to stand on her own two feet - on her own terms. Annette is caught off guard when Du Toit shares his truth. Debbie-Lee takes the bull by the horns and confronts Tjoppie with reality. Brenda struggles to cope with her new circumstances, while Joyce decides to return to Bergvallei. Esther is back and Junior has an unwelcome message for her.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Annette is not ready for a relationship, but is also of the opinion that a few dates won’t do harm. Esther causes drama and tension on Soebatskloof when she claims what is hers and later on brings the police to the farm. Tjoppie is unsure why Junior is fighting so hard for Haley, while CJ makes all kinds of promises to Brenda. Shireen is jealous when Warren’s focus is not on her, and Debbie-Lee finds out the full truth regarding the situation at the restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Hermien has advice for Annette on Du Toit. CJ decides to move his family back to the Marais manor, and Brenda finds out how desperate CJ is to keep Haley. Hermien’s warning and CJ's outburst motivates Junior to move his focus elsewhere. Napoleon warns everyone against Warren, while Warren informs Hermien about his big dream.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Sandy’s jokes could destroy a romantic date, while Gideon Malan makes Warren an irresistible offer. Tjoppie serves Veronique with divorce papers - and asks her to leave the farm. Brenda asks Joyce for advice concerning CJ and Haley, while Gershwin wants to prevent Brenda from returning to Soebatskloof. Veronique’s heart hardens when Brenda tells her what she saw.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Dewald prepares CJ and Brenda for a court case like no other, but Esther warns them about their chances. Shireen is unsure about what is happening: Warren’s behavior towards here has changed dramatically. Annette and Du Toit decide to not ignore their history - and Annette advises Tjoppie to give Veronique a second chance. Veronique accuses Tjoppie of a secret affair.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Veronique makes a shocking announcement at a dinner that is called to unite the family. Lynn makes a surprise entrance and sweeps Annette off her feet. Warren decides about Gideon’s offer - while the Soebatskloof name is not the only important name that is being discussed. Tjoppie and Du Toit receive kisses that could get tongues wagging…

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: CJ and Esther try to discuss the best way forward for Haley, and Esther can’t help but be impressed with CJ’s plans. Du Toit and Annette get closer to each other, while Veronique does her best to ensure that Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee don’t follow the same path - she makes sure that her words sound very believable! Warren invites his workers for a braai, and gives Napoleon new responsibilities.

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Du Toit says exactly the right things when Hermien and Tjoppie are nearby. Veronique, convinced that Tjoppie’s plans are focused on her, can’t wait to bring it to Debbie-Lee’s attention. Warren gives Napoleon the necessary things to be able to perform his job, while Tjoppie is brandmarked as the guilty party when an accident occurs on the farm.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: The Marais family bid CJ and Brenda farewell for now, while Annette and Du Toit have to make a decision on what they want to do next in life. Veronique steals Tjoppie’s wallet in order to buy something unholy. Debbie-Lee tells Sandy a little white lie so that she can continue her plans in silence. Warren tells Shireen a little bit about his past.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Du Toit does the unexpected, and Annette has an unpredictable reaction. Warren sees something suspect on the farm, while he has to tell Shireen exactly how things are going between him and her. Debbie-Lee has to tell Shireen the truth about her weekend away - and then she lands up in the cross hairs of Veronique.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Sandy and Marco are upset over the fact that the truth wasn’t shared with them. Debbie-Lee is concerned about the fact that her truth is now out there - as well as the uncertainty of the situation that she finds herself in. Joyce shares her opinion on Veronique’s plans for revenge - and what she thinks she should do next. Warren confronts a man that he doesn’t know -and is shocked to find out how he fits into the picture. Annette shares her fears with Hermien, while Lynn encourages Du Toit.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Gideon puts pressure on Warren to do something that will put Soebatskloof on the market. There is a big reason for festivities on Soebatskloof - and those festivities begin in the restaurant. Marco and Sandy kick up such a fuss that Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie have to re-think their relationship. Veronqiue sees something that motivates her to immediately start doing her homework.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee shares her heart with Shireen, while Tjoppie's sole focus is on the crisis in the vineyard. Napoleon takes full responsibility for the crisis, but not everyone thinks that he should carry that burden. Hermien tries to persuade Warren to let Tjoppie help with the crisis. Shireen and Annette celebrate Charlie's first birthday in a meaningful way.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Tjoppie hands the new divorce papers to Veronique - a few amendments have been noted. Debbie-Lee is offered the chance of a lifetime: an internship in Paris, France. The men work uninterrupted to save the vineyard, and Tjoppie confronts Warren with his suspicions. While the matriculants celebrate the end of their exams, there is a new ghost on the loose on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee decides to put herself first - she accepts the internship. Hermien's fear that she will lose everything worsens. Veronique aligns herself with Warren, and speaks out against Tjoppie. When baked goods start to disappear from the kitchen, the boys decide to start doing something about it.

videos.title: Episode 154
videos.overview: Warren needs to persuade Gideon to put their plans on ice, as he fears they might be caught out but then... Veronique's curiosity gets the better of her, and she finds out who Gideon is. Tjoppie believes that the divorce will be quick and painless, which makes Debbie-Lee question things and then she makes a proposal that catches Tjoppie off guard. Athandwa and Marco have a plan to lay the ghost to rest but then the ghost loses a bangle that could be a clue to their identity.

videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: A 21st party on the farm turns into a nightmare when the guests all start getting sick. Hermien asks for a full investigation as soon as the partygoers blood test results become available. Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie make a very big decision regarding their future, and the ghost eventually gets a name.

videos.title: Episode 156
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee's heart is shattered shortly before she leaves for Paris. Warren uncovers Gideon's real plans for Soebatskloof and Veronique doesn't make things any easier. Dewald shares the unsettling bloodtest results of the partygoers, and Marco works with a very goal-orientated plan.

videos.title: Episode 157
videos.overview: andy and Shireen are not at all impressed with Tjoppie. A surprise kiss from Warren is a ploy so that Shireen won't notice what is right in front of her. Hermien's surprising statement catches Tjoppie off guard and gives him something that he thought was lost forever. Veronique plays open cards with Warren, and CJ and Brenda arrive back on the farm to help Marco find what he's looking for.

videos.title: Episode 158
videos.overview: Tjoppie and Warren try to find a way to work together, but their relationship is very fragile. Unathi asks Phillip if he can use his house for a small gathering, and Phillip properly feels like an outsider. Veronique knows just how to use her silver tongue when she meets with Gideon and then she warns him against Warren. Brenda starts to suspect that there is more to the past than CJ told her. Warren blurts out his plans for Soebatskloof to Joey and Shireen.

videos.title: Episode 159
videos.overview: Hermien and Tjoppie decide to apply for a part of Soebatskloof to be declared as a heritage site. Shireen and Warren are falling hard for each other, but it doesn't get any approval from Veronique and when Shireen sees her and Warren together, she warns him against her. Phillip feels isolated from the rest of the Soebatsklowers, especially with Unathis parties, and invites himself to Shireen for the night. Brenda discovers a letter that lays the depth of the past out, and when she confronts CJ about it it leads to a huge falling out.

videos.title: Episode 160
videos.overview: Tjoppie intercepts a parcel that is addressed to Warren Ferreira and Tjoppie doesn't need to be invited twice to confront Warren about the surname change. Phillip's loneliness is a topic of conversation. Brenda tries to do the good thing and confronts CJ about his feelings. CJ discusses matters of the heart with Marco, and Marco gives his brother advice concerning the difficult position he finds himself in.

videos.title: Episode 161
videos.overview: Tjoppie's questions lead him to the truth, and Hermien is not impressed with what her son finds - she decides to confront Warren. Meanwhile, Sandy gives her blessing to whatever is happening between Warren and Shireen. Philip meets a pretty girl, and he is immediately infatuated. Marco and Athandwa start working on their charity project, while Brenda removes herself from a situation in order for CJ to sort out his feelings once and for all.

videos.title: Episode 162
videos.overview: Veronique informs Gideon about what is going on with Warren and proposes that they start making their own plans without Warren. Hermien is at a cross roads when Tjoppie makes demands of his own because of Hermien's decision regarding Warren. Octavia is contacted regarding a business proposal. Phillip can't stop talking about Saskia. Athandwa and Marco's project is a huge success, and CJ does something that could potentially ruin his relationship.

videos.title: Episode 163
videos.overview: Veronique seduces Gerrit, one of Tjoppie's good friends, and then blackmails him and also plants the idea of a silent partner. Phillip decides not to hang out with the men so that he can spend more time with Saskia. Marco encourages CJ to fight for Brenda, but there is a snake in the grass and her name is Joyce!

videos.title: Episode 164
videos.overview: Warren is thrown when Veronique informs him that Gideon knows about his past and that there is another plan already in the works. Hermien is caught off guard when Tjoppie makes an announcement and it puts a huge smile on Veronique's face. Phillip wants to introduce Saskia to the Systers, while Sandy warns him about the amount of money he is spending on the girl. CJ devises a plan to win Brenda back, while Gershwin has advice for Brenda regarding her wedding ring.

videos.title: Episode 165
videos.overview: Hermien has no other choice but to sign the documents when Junior declines to become a partner. Sandy shares her suspicions about Saskia with Nenna and Joey, while Phillip and Saskia skip the family dinner at Shireens. Marco comes up with a plan to help CJ save his marriage, but when the plan is set in motion Marco sees Ruben at Brendas and a new form of hell starts.

videos.title: Episode 166
videos.overview: Gerrit shocks everyone with the truth: it is actually Veronique who invested in Soebatskloof! Everyone looks to Dewald for answers regarding getting out of the partnership deal. Phillip introduces Saskia to a few of his inner-circle friends, but it is Stil Piet that thinks he recognizes her. CJ calls in assistance to mediate his situation with Brenda and Grace is ready to do the right thing.

videos.title: Episode 167
videos.overview: Hermien tries to kick Veronique out of the house, while Veronique discovers information that will derail her and Gideons plans and Gideon gives Veronique a deadly task. Stil Piet remembers where he saw Saskia, while Phillip spends most of his money on a Christmas gift for her. CJ tries his best to reinstate peace in the Solomon household.

videos.title: Episode 168
videos.overview: Veronique's revenge plans include a hitman but it's Shireen who has a close shave with death. Warren decides to play open cards with Hermien. CJ pleads with Granny to help reinstate peace between Joyce and Brenda and Hermien invites Joyce and Gershwin to spend Christmas with the Marais family. Nenna is deeply shocked when Phillip tells her about everything that is going on in his life.

videos.title: Episode 169
videos.overview: Christmas on Soebatskloof is a festive time and not just because Debbie-Lee returns from Paris! Stil Piet and Phillip are the heroes of the day when they defuse a threatening danger. Shireen arrives just in time when Warren wants to divulge his sins, and Joyce talks Gershwin into accompanying her to Soebatskloof. CJ is surprised by a valuable Christmas gift.

videos.title: Episode 170
videos.overview: Warren declares his love for Shireen and then gives the media something to write about! Warren gives Hermien and Tjoppie all the evidence they need to corroborate his stories to the media and Hermien fires him on the spot. Veronique is relieved that her name didn't come out of his mouth but Warren's revenge is sweet. Gershwin's obsession with Veronique starts all over again.

videos.title: Episode 171
videos.overview: Edmund Abrahams returns to Soebatskloof unexpectedly. Warren warns Hermien against Veronique and Hermien decides it is time to confront her. Debbie-Lee has a very clear message for Tjoppie, and shortly afterwards she and Phillip make a big decision. Gershwin decides that it is now or never, and Veronique has to think fast on her feet. A moment between Athandwa and Marco causes great discomfort.

videos.title: Episode 172
videos.overview: Shireen tries to determine whether things between her and Warren meant something, while Tjoppie tries to make things right with Debbie-Lee. Marco's idea of a New Year's celebration leads to another unexpected incident with Athandwa and a dream. Edmund's return to Soebatskloof is a joyous relief but Vernoique seems to be the only one that doesn't feel it.

videos.title: Episode 173
videos.overview: A familiar face from Hermien's past unexpectedly appears on Soebatskloof on New Years Eve, while Veronique grows increasingly frustrated with Tjoppie who only has eyes for Debbie-Lee. Shireen follows her heart: she asks Warren to move in with her. Joyce tries to cheer up a very sour Gershwin with her wishes for 2026 for him. Marco takes a risky step at midnight.

videos.title: Episode 174
videos.overview: New Years Eve on Soebatskloof is a storm but is it in a tea cup or a punch bowl? Is Sandy or Nenna responsible for the headaches after the party? Edmund and Chrystal size each other up. The Systers are shocked by Shireen's actions, while the whole farm looks for Unathi who disappeared with a few traces. How do Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee deal with their actions of the previous night?

videos.title: Episode 175
videos.overview: Edmund introduces the workers to Chrystal, while Hermien informs the rest of the Marais family of their new guest. Joey lands up in hospital over Shireen's choices and Nenna does not hold back in a confrontation. Gershwin makes a promise known to Veronique, while Junior arrives with an unpleasant surprise!

videos.title: Episode 176
videos.overview: Tjoppie's discomfort with Chrystal in the house is very clear but not as clear as Hermien's anger towards Octavia. Octavia is a sharpshooter and she will not let her good deeds go unnoticed. Debbie-Lee has to make a very big decision, while Joey's health and Shireen's love life drives the Systers apart. Warren feels exceptionally guilty about what Shireen is going through.

videos.title: Episode 177
videos.overview: Octavia Marais is back in all her glory on her beloved Soebatskloof and she makes sure that everyone knows it, especially her business partner. She shares a very big secret with CJ. Chrystal's presence has tongues wagging in and out of the Marais mansion but it is her behaviour towards Napoleon that really gets the gossip mill going. Joey is not planning on forgiving and forgetting anytime soon, while Shireen stands by her choices.

videos.title: Episode 178
videos.overview: There is a letter on the kitchen table waiting for Shireen that might change her whole future. Octavia's clever plans are quickly stopped by Edmund and Octavia takes her rage out on Veronique. Tjoppie doesn't trust Chrystal at all and let's something slip that he thought was common knowledge. Junior's loyalty is pulled into question.

videos.title: Episode 179
videos.overview: Chrystal confronts Tjoppie about his loose mouth, while Octavia shows Veronique exactly how dangerous she can be when she wants to. Hermien is seriously worried about the future of the farm under the reign of Octavia and Veronique, and Tjoppie makes her a promise. Gershwin wants to make life a lot easier for Veronique but realizes quickly enough that Veronique has plans of her own. Nenna wants to reach out to Shireen, but Joey forbids it.

videos.title: Episode 180
videos.overview: Chrystal tells the rest of the workers half of the truth, while Veronique pushes to have a function for Octavia that gets Edmund's back up. Shireen doesn't think she has anything to apologise for, while Tjoppie and Junior have a huge falling out and CJ and Marco walk in on the fight.

videos.title: Episode 181
videos.overview: The matric results leave some people celebrating, while others are completely stunned. Octavia believes she is completely in control when the day of the networking function arrives. Chrystal finds herself in a very difficult position when she snoops around in Hermien's room and Sandy walks in. Veronique and Octavia are not the only two poisonous serpents on Soebatskloof. Edmund asks Hermien some very difficult questions after a very upsetting interaction with Chrystal.

videos.title: Episode 183
videos.overview: Octavia is rushed to hospital with a snake bite, and while she's there, fighting for her life, it looks like a dark cloud is forming over Soebatskloof. Hermien feels very hurt when Chrystal makes it very clear that they are not friends. Tjoppie feels responsible for Marco, and goes looking for solace in Debbie-Lee and later on Shireen realizes what is really going on. CJ tries to encourage Marco regarding the future, while Edmund witnesses Chrystal doing something in the vineyard.

videos.title: Episode 184
videos.overview: Veronique can't wait to tell everyone that Octavia didn't make it and even calls Annette with the really sad news. Chrystal tells Edmund why she doesn't like Napoleon. Sandy begins her investigation into the disappearance of Hermien's very sentimental earrings. Athandwa and Debbie-Lee have words with Marco: some of them angry, others more goal-orientated.

videos.title: Episode 185
videos.overview: Junior pleads with Hermien to make peace with Octavia. Tjoppie is proud of the decisions that Marco is making, while his relationship with Debbie-Lee deepens with another passionate kiss. Joyce is shocked to her foundation when she finds out what Veronique has done and what she is planning to do next. Hermien unknowningly becomes Octavia's guardian angel. Chrystal tries to make things right.

videos.title: Episode 186
videos.overview: Bad news for Octavia could be the missing ingredient to build a bridge between her and Hermien. Edmund doesn't know what to do with the fact that Hermien didn't have a headache. Joyce tries to talk sense into Veronique's head, and Joey wasn't born yesterday: he knows the signs of a heart beating faster. Sandy is concerned about other things going missing in the Marais mansion. Veronique is on the warpath for Marco.

videos.title: Episode 187
videos.overview: Junior doesn't receive the news he was hoping for, and he asks the family to jump in and help to save a life. CJ's surprise for Octavia only aggravates Veronique, while Marco discusses his mothers newest crusade with Athandwa. Edmund confronts Chrystal about Hermiens earrings, while a sketch reveals nicknames for old enemies.

videos.title: Episode 188
videos.overview: CJ's new car causes jealousy, while a call and news from the doctor gives Octavia a new lease on life. Chrystal doesn't want to accept Edmund's apology, while Sandy does a stock take to see exactly what has gone missing in the Marais mansion. Tjoppie surprises Debbie-Lee with a straight answer after her straight question and Marco brightens up Debbie-Lee's day.

videos.title: Episode 189
videos.overview: Octavia experiences a severe setback, and it seems like circumstances will force the anonymous donor out of their anonymity sooner than later. Veronique is focused on finding out who the mysterious person is. Debbie-Lee is concerned about her job when Hermien catches her and Tjoppie stealing kisses. Phillip takes a stand against Napoleon - and asks Chrystal out! Napoleon gives Sandy an idea on the identity of the potential thief.

videos.title: Episode 190
videos.overview: Brenda is concerned about CJ as he has gone missing - without any trace. Dr Brandt has news on Octavia's operation. Debbie-Lee is worried about how her family will react if they should find out that she in a relationship with Tjoppie. Edmund sees another interaction between Phillip and Chrystal that makes him uncomfortable and puts Tjoppie in a compromising situation. Octavia's condition worsens.

videos.title: Episode 191
videos.overview: Octavia is devastated by CJ's sacrifice and even more so when Veronique accuses her of bribery. Edmund takes Napoleon out for a drink at the same bar where Phillip and Chrystal are having their date. Veronique arrives at the hospital to support Tjoppie, but freaks out when she sees who he is praying with.

videos.title: Episode 192
videos.overview: Veronique demands that CJ be moved to another hospital and Brenda makes it very clear who is in charge. Phillip confronts Edmund regarding his feelings for Chrystal. Debbie-Lee feels helpless: she can't be with Tjoppie, and she can't do anything for CJ.

videos.title: Episode 193
videos.overview: Brenda is still holding strong when it comes to decisions regarding CJ, while Debbie-Lee confronts Tjoppie regarding the Marais family's treatment of Brenda. Edmund tells Chrystal what he feels, while Chrystal plays open cards with Phillip. Octavia pleads with CJ to wake up.

videos.title: Episode 194
videos.overview: There is a good explanation and an honourable one! why CJ did what he did. Veronique tries to keep Octavia away from CJ, while Debbie-Lee avoids the hospital so that she is not in the way. Dr Brandt explains what is happening with CJ, and Phillip is concerned when it sounds like Chrystal is saying goodbye to them. Edmund is anxious when he can't find Charl Senior's watch.

videos.title: Episode 195
videos.overview: Brenda eventually hears a very big secret and must then keep her poise when Tjoppie walks into the room. Edmund follows his gut instincts, derails Chrystals plans, and surprises her with his actions. Sandy has a heart to heart with Debbie-Lee and later on Tjoppie asks Debbie-Lee what she really wants. Octavia and Junior are read the riot act regarding a secret.

videos.title: Episode 196
videos.overview: Crystal tries to calm Edmund down when harvest time on Soebatskloof doesn’t kick off on the right foot. Octavia’s good news leads her to concoct more risky plans, while Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee’s relationship eventually becomes a focus point for both of them. Brenda struggles to get used to CJ’s secret, and makes it very clear that she doesn’t want to live a life that is muddled with secrets.

videos.title: Episode 197
videos.overview: Junior decides to buy Soebatskloof. CJ is discharged, and wants to immediately leave to visit Haley. Sandy feels uncomfortable having dinner with the Marais family in her uniform. Tjoppie hopes that Debbie-Lee will sleep over - and that their romance will drive Veronique away. Veronique doesn’t want to sign Octavia’s documents. Crystal tells Edmund her whole story, while Phillip sees what he must see…

videos.title: Episode 198
videos.overview: Jan surprises Hermien, not just with an unexpected visit, but also with a very startling question. Breakfast at the Marais Mansion gets uncomfortable when Debbie-Lee takes her place at Tjoppie’s side - and Sandy feels uncomfortable because she has to serve her. Octavia circles Veronique with a ruthless ultimatum, and also ropes in Joyce to get things moving. Edmund has a very deep and honest conversation with Crystal.

videos.title: Episode 199
videos.overview: Hermien is concerned how people will handle her newest news - especially Christiaan. Marco reaches out to Jan to broker peace. Sandy is upset because she feels that Debbie-Lee is treating her like she works for her. Octavia gives Edmund the opportunity to sell his shares to her - and then Junior also makes the same play. Everyone can see how the dynamic between Edmund and Crystal is changing.

videos.title: Episode 200
videos.overview: Octavia gives Junior an ultimatum: either he gets Edmund to play along, or she will start playing dirty. Edmund gets a very big offer from Junior, and Joey lets him know exactly how he feels about the situation. Octavia worms her way into Hermien’s wedding - at the cost of Nenna - and Jan asks Christaan a very big question. Sandy is rubbed up the wrong way when Tjoppie insists that Debbie-Lee sits down for breakfast. Crystal makes a move on Edmund, and it leads to a very loaded moment.

videos.title: Episode 201
videos.overview: Jan is determined to marry Hermien - with or without Christiaan’s blessing. A friendship freaks out Veronique - and then she overhears Edmund talking about the offer. Debbie-Lee and Sandy have a huge blow out when Debbie-Lee has had enough of her mother’s behaviour. Shireen lands up in the middle of the fight. Crystal gives Edmund very wise advice, and Marco feels guilty when he overhears the topic of Hermien and Nenna’s discussion.

videos.title: Episode 202
videos.overview: CJ, Brenda and Haley are not the only guests that arrive on the farm in preparation for Jan and Hermien's big wedding. Junior needs to investigate terms and conditions. Annette and Octavia see each other for the first time after Annette discovered the truth. Tjoppie wants to broker peace with Christiaan, while Edmund needs to make a huge decision. Nenna has her hands full with a kitchen tea and Debbie-Lee.

videos.title: Episode 203
videos.overview: Annette shares her hard words with Octavia - with her full chest. Tjoppie offers to try and broker peace with Christiaan, while Tjoppie realises that something is wrong between Debbie-Lee and Sandy. Christiaan arrives at the bacherlor and bachelorette masked ball, and gives Jan something that he wasn’t expecting.

videos.title: Episode 204
videos.overview: It is time for Jan and Hermien to promise forever to each other. Brenda and Annette help Hermien get ready for her big day, while Jan is without a best man. Edmund asks Crystal to be his date for the wedding, while Nenna is concerned about Octavia’s plans. Marco feels too guilty to attend the wedding, and Tjoppie promises to make things right with Sandy. There are eyes in the shadows that don’t miss anyone or anything.

videos.title: Episode 205
videos.overview: Jan receives an unexpected call right before the wedding cake is to be cut. Gershwin invites himself over to where Veronique is babysitting Haley - and a strange teddy bear is found near the little girl. Octavia’s caterers underestimated the number of guests at the wedding – and Nenna is ready to say something. Napoleon causes a lot of drama at the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 206
videos.overview: Octavia is concerned about Hermien and Jan’s honeymoon plans, while Hermien suggests something that would give them more time together. Joyce is concerned about Elroy, and also suggests that Haley be christened. Someone is listening in on various conversations without anyone else knowing. Tjoppie worsens the situation between Debbie-Lee and Sandy. Jan lies to Hermien about the phone call.

videos.title: Episode 207
videos.overview: Jan and Hermien meet Pieter, another camper on the terrain - and then Jan is forced to lie to Hermien again when she catches him with his phone. Octavia leaves Soebatskloof as a consequence to Junior’s decisions, while Edmund follows his heart. Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee have a huge falling out because of Sandy, and Gershwin’s life is in danger when a car speeds towards him.

videos.title: Episode 208
videos.overview: Jan’s attitude towards a mouthy Pieter upsets Hermien. Edmund makes it clear to Crystal that he was serious about his plans, and Junior finds out that Brenda knows everything. CJ is not at all interested in inheriting Soebatskloof, and things go south quickly for Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee. Gershwin gets another threat (this time in the form of a black suit), while someone makes notes of all the conversations they are listening in on. At Charl Senior’s grave his real murderer is unmasked.

videos.title: Episode 209
videos.overview: Edmund gets a surprising answer from Crystal. Gershwin shares his plan on how to catch Elroy, but unfortunately for Gershwin the car does not miss its target this time around. Edmund makes a surprising suggestion to Junior on who he thinks the new cellar master should be. Hermien and Jan return a lot earlier from their honeymoon - and Jan makes an appointment with Amelia.

videos.title: Episode 210
videos.overview: Jan is confronted with his past when he comes face to face with Lida and Amelia. Veronique’s attempt, to control the farm, proceeds according to plan. Edmund prepares for his departure to Italy. Warren appears at Shireen’s front door. Haley’s christening turns into a big drama when Gershwin doesn’t make an appearance, and Haley disappears into thin air.

videos.title: Episode 211
videos.overview: Haley’s christening turns into a nightmare, and CJ blames Brenda for his daughter’s disappearance. Veronique is not letting grass grow under her feet: she climbs into Brenda, until Hermien arrives. Debbie-Lee must watch Tjoppie comforting Veronique, and Esther doesn’t hold back towards CJ. Joyce is busy taking care of Brenda when she gets an earthshattering call - and then she comes to the wrong conclusion that Elroy is sitting behind it all.

videos.title: Episode 212
videos.overview: Veronique is convinced that Elroy is the man behind the disappearance of Haley, and concocts a plan to lure him in - with the help of Brenda. CJ is so livid with Brenda that he doesn’t speak to her, and keeps vigil at the church. Jan hears what the future holds for Lida - and what is expected of him. In an interview, Esther names the person that she thinks is behind Haley’s disappearance.

videos.title: Episode 213
videos.overview: The Marais family has to face Esther and Sabrine, but the main gate rapports that there are protesters. CJ makes a quick plan with the unwanted masses of people. Junior makes it known that there is a huge amount of money for any information that will bring Haley home safely. Veronique tortures Elry, and the master brain is revealed to be Chrisentia’s boss. Jan tells Amelia his truth, and Amelia tries to sell Australia as a solution. Gershwin regains consciousness, and Joyce goes against Veronique’s will…

videos.title: Episode 214
videos.overview: Veronique is shocked when the teddybear starts talking to her. Jan tells Lida the whole truth, but she still begs him to stay with her. Warren makes an announcement that makes the workers see red, and Tjoppie is, once again, extremely angry with Hermien. A recent truth is explained again - so that the real truth can become a fact.

videos.title: Episode 215
videos.overview: Tongues are wagging again about Warren who's making himself at home on Soebatskskloof, but the man is not listening to the gossip- he just wants to start working on the farm again. Hermien has a stern talking to her family, and advises them that it is best to bang together. Veronique is beyond scared, and tells Joyce who is really responsible for Haley’s disappearance, but Joyce does not believe her. Later, Veronique gets a very upsetting mission to complete.

videos.title: Episode 216
videos.overview: Gershwin is completely caught off guard when Joyce makes very sure that he returns home - and she tells him the truth about who is really the mastermind behind all the ‘bad luck’ they’re experiencing. Joey is not planning on making things easy for Warren: he keeps his eye on him. Esther tries to broker peace between her and CJ – but on her terms. Veronique ropes in Trevor to help her to get closer to Allistair.

videos.title: Episode 217
videos.overview: Tjoppie doesn’t just give his permission for the Druiwe Dans to take place – he also asks some of the workers to begin the preparations. Warren is not sure what a winemaker should know about pumps, paths, and pipes – and Joey doesn’t make things easier for him. Allistair’s plan with Haley is revealed, and then he has a surprise for Veornique on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 218
videos.overview: CJ can’t sit around the house waiting for answers; he asks Brenda to go look for answers with him. A supper invitation surprises the Syster household. Octavia arrives unexpectedly on Soebatskloof. Veronique’s desperate search brings her face to face with her father – and the extreme confrontation that takes place will have huge consequences.

videos.title: Episode 219
videos.overview: A big secret that needs to be laid to rest could also be the beginning of a brand-new understanding. A set of keys could unlock the right room, but doesn’t mean Haley is safe. Debbie-Lee realises something that comes as a big shock. Shireen suddenly feels unsure about Warren.

videos.title: Episode 220
videos.overview: CJ, Brenda, and Veronique play against time to sort out the security on a phone. Debbie-Lee gets an unexpected result. Shireen takes Warren home but gives him an ultimatum. The tension is getting to Esther.

videos.title: Episode 221
videos.overview: CJ demands to spend time alone with his child, while Brenda doesn’t think it is a good idea. Nenna and Joey don’t make it easy for Debbie-Lee to hide her news, and Sandy begins to suspect something is amiss. Warren gives Phillip and Napoleon a reason to be concerned, while Shireen feels that he is once again hiding something.

videos.title: Episode 222
videos.overview: Lucky shows up at Shireen’s house and reveals things to her that she hardly can believe. Brenda reveals that CJ is on the run with baby Haley – with Veronique’s assistance – but asks that it be kept a secret as to keep CJ and Haley safe. A blanket leads to a big revelation.

videos.title: Episode 223
videos.overview: Shireen is prepared to listen to Warren’s whole story regarding Lucky. Sandy goes with Debbie-Lee for her first appointment – and receives news that they really didn’t expect. Octavia makes it clear to Veronique that she won't be leaving Soebatskloof before CJ and Haley are back. Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie share their stories of the day with each other.

videos.title: Episode 224
videos.overview: Veronique has bigger problems on hand than the visits from her father: Warren wants to plant where Veronique’s secrets are hidden. Warren and Lucky are at extreme loggerheads with each other, and Shireen is kind of in the middle of it all. Debbie-Lee is concerned about the future, while Joey encourages her to speak to her beloved.

videos.title: Episode 225
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee tells Nenna about her plans with Tjoppie, while both of them think it is a step in the right direction. Shireen tells Sandy that she knows how it feels to grow up without a dad, but Sandy doesn’t want to talk about it. It is very clear that Lucky is also hiding a secret from his father. Octavia has a plan that will prevent Warren from using a piece of land on the farm. Veronique has an idea on how to get rid of her father, but it takes its toll.

videos.title: Episode 226
videos.overview: Veronique is not coping, and Octavia is the one that notices. Brenda is caught off guard when Veronique chases her away, and Lucky turns on the charm when he meets the Systers for the first time – and he is also immediately impressed when he meets Brenda. Warren shows Lucky that he is not such a bad father as Lucky thinks. Jan begins to feel guilty about his many lies.

videos.title: Episode 227
videos.overview: Shireen overhears Lucky’s plan with Warren, and she confronts him about it. Veronique’s behaviour is taken to task when Nenna confronts her about it: Veronique breaks down in Nenna’s arms. Jan shows up a little intoxicated at the house but blames his circumstances. Lucky’s interest in Brenda is piqued when Brenda gives him lip.

videos.title: Episode 228
videos.overview: Lucky’s feelings of guilt are eating away at him, and he decides to play open cards with Warren – especially when Shireen and Warren’s relationship bleeds because of him. Jan decides to make himself useful by joining the workforce – and Joey feels he might be getting replaced. Nenna shares her concerns about Veronique with Octavia and Hermine – and Octavia decides to bring an end to Veronique’s anguish. Sandy talks to Hermien about Esther – and how the Marais family functions without Haley.

videos.title: Episode 229
videos.overview: Joey gives Nenna a reason for concern when he walks around in his robe all day long. Octavia informs Veronique that Junior is on his way to London, and Veronique decides to organise a press conference to explain how the Marais family are getting on with life without Haley. The Systers accept Lucky in their midsts, and an upsetting news paper article does the rounds.

videos.title: Episode 230
videos.overview: Brenda tells Debbie-Lee that she thinks the writing is on the wall for her and CJ. Veronique and Tjoppie try to find CJ so they can persuade him not to flee with Haley any further. Nenna fears that she has broken Joey’s trust and heart when Jan advises him to do more exercises. Brenda wants to kiss Lucky…

videos.title: Episode 231
videos.overview: Veronique needs to come up with a plan to get Haley back on Soebatskloof without implicating CJ in any way. Lucky finds out that Brenda is married, and Brenda decides that it would be best if she moves back to Bergvallei – Octavia supports her all the way. Joey decides that he wants to turn his life around with exercise – and he asks Warren for help.

videos.title: Episode 232
videos.overview: Joey’s exercise regime is an inspiration for the other men on the farm, but Nenna is deeply concerned with the amount of money he is spending. CJ wants to talk to Brenda when he realises that she has returned to Bergvallei – but she doesn’t want to talk to him. Veronique’s next phase of her plan includes Chrisentia – and it will cost her dearly. Brenda asks Lucky to move in with her at Bergvallei.

videos.title: Episode 233
videos.overview: Esther discharges herself from the hospital when she sees Chrisentia’s video – and she goes directly to Soebatskloof. Joey tries to hide a sports injury from Nenna. The friendship between Lucky and Brenda deepens, and he advises her to speak to CJ.

videos.title: Episode 234
videos.overview: Esther makes a shocking announcement at the press conference. Nenna is concerned about Joey’s fitness regime and asks Shireen’s assistance. Shireen suggests that Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie visit a fertility clinic. Brenda comes to a decision regarding her future with CJ, after she sees CJ with someone else.

videos.title: Episode 235
videos.overview: Veronique convinces Tjoppie to put CJ first, and move his plans with Haley – which means that he will have to let his battle with Esther go. Lucky has had enough of Warren’s lies, and wants to move out of the house: Shireen gives Warren an ultimatum. Marco is shocked to hear what Brenda has been doing, and Shireen knows what is going on with her grandfather

videos.title: Episode 236
videos.overview: Veronique finds peace in someone’s arms, while Brenda and CJ talk to each other like adults. Warren shares a very big secret with Lucky. Joey longs for visits from the kids, and Tjoppie shows Debbie-Lee his idea of their future.

videos.title: Episode 237
videos.overview: Tjoppie’s news threatens to unearth family secrets, while Debbie-Lee shops for the news that she thinks they will be getting. Veronique finds peace in the current reality of CJ and Brenda. Lucky explains to Brenda what exactly is happening in his life.

videos.title: Episode 238
videos.overview: Tjoppie spirals after learning the truth about his sons, Warren is chased out of Bergvallei by Lucky, and a fight breaks out between Junior and Tjoppie.

videos.title: Episode 239
videos.overview: The aftershocks of Hermien's revelation reverberate through Soebatskloof. The search for a missing Tjoppie leads to a shocking discovery. CJ and Marco make their own plan to bring back their father.

videos.title: Episode 240
videos.overview: Marco and CJ have their work cut out handling Tjoppie. Hermien tries to protect Tjoppie. The bond between Brenda and Lucky grows stronger. Nenna gets a pleasant surprise.

videos.title: Episode 241
videos.overview: Marco and CJ take drastic steps to save a spiralling Tjoppie, only to be blindsided by shocking news of Junior's disappearance.

videos.title: Episode 242
videos.overview: Hermien is desperate to keep the police away from Tjoppie as Debbie-Lee decides she is done with secrets. Brenda faces an impossible choice, and Marco forces CJ to choose a side in the war tearing the family apart.

videos.title: Episode 243
videos.overview: Warren comes clean about Lucky's mom. Tjoppie and the boys return home, confronting Veronique and the media.

videos.title: Episode 244
videos.overview: Shireen gives Warren an ultimatum. Tjoppie makes a confession. Veronique plans to play dirty to stay on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 245
videos.overview: Veronique refuses to leave Soebatskloof. Joey feels betrayed by Charl Senior. Marco breaks down. Is Tjoppie going to confess?

videos.title: Episode 246
videos.overview: Joey and Nenna struggle to come to terms with Charl Senior's dark secret. Debbie-Lee is shattered to find out Tjoppie is infertile. Shireen and Warren is at a crossroads. Hermien lays down the law for her family.

videos.title: Episode 247
videos.overview: Warren's decision to walk away sends shockwaves through the farm, leaving Shireen heartbroken and forced to face a painful goodbye.

videos.title: Episode 248
videos.overview: Marco's buried rage threatens to consume everything Soebatskloof holds dear, as CJ faces a choice between protecting his family's lies or unleashing truths that could destroy them all.

videos.title: Episode 249
videos.overview: The Solomons receive damning news. Tjoppie and Shireen both move on, while Veronique has another trick up her sleeve. Marco lets out his rage, before new revelations threaten to end the Marais's for good.

videos.title: Episode 250
videos.overview: Tjoppie breaks ties with Soebatskloof. Octavia demands answers. The Marais's darkest secrets are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 251
videos.overview: Marco's fury toward his mother hardens into something far more ominous when Jason challenges him to act instead of wish.

videos.title: Episode 252
videos.overview: A shocking legal bombshell hands Veronique the keys to the Marais kingdom, igniting a firestorm between the family's most formidable women.

videos.title: Episode 253
videos.overview: While Veronique exploits her new power, a new Mrs Marais lands on the farm. Gershwin encourages Brenda to divorce CJ and get her pound of flesh. Octavia shares a big secret with Hermien.

videos.title: Episode 254
videos.overview: The workers are called to meet again, while Debbie-Lee gets a surprising offer. CJ refuses to sign divorce papers and Rachel takes on Veronique.

videos.title: Episode 255
videos.overview: Rachel will tolerate no further disrespect. Javin shows his creative side. Ella arrives with devastating news. Marco confronts Veronique.

videos.title: Episode 256
videos.overview: Phillip puts Sabrine in her place. Marco reveals the truth about Veronique's accident. Brenda breaks up a fight between CJ and Gerswhin.

videos.title: Episode 257
videos.overview: Marco and CJ struggle after their mother's accident, leaving Hermien and Octavia unsure how to support them. Gershwin is livid when he realises someone pushed Veronique, and Javin urgently seeks help.

videos.title: Episode 258
videos.overview: As Veronique remains in a coma, the Marais family begins to fracture under pressure. Rachel tightens her grip on Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 259
videos.overview: CJ tells Octavia and Hermien a secret, and then a plan needs to be made to get Marco the help that he needs. Gershwin gives Brenda money for an attorney to help her with her divorce. Joey is excited about taking Javin to school - but then Javin lands up in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 260
videos.overview: Just when CJ needs Brenda the most, he receives something from her. Hermien tells Octavia that they should stop fighting with Rachel, for now, and then Rachel drops a pretty big bombshell. Javin tries to explain to Joey and Nenna what happened at school, and then Maria shows up to fetch him. Brenda and Gershwin receive very bad news.

videos.title: Episode 261
videos.overview: The Marais family is caught off guard when Rachel doesn’t just reveal that Junior is alive – but that she also knows where he is. Octavia is stunned when Rachel wants to work with her. CJ makes the brave decision to fight for his marriage and offers Brenda and Gershwin an unexpected lifebuoy. Joey and Nenna are panicky when they find out that Javin has disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 262
videos.overview: Joey and Nenna needs to make a big decision about Javin. Rachel dangles a carrot in front of Octavia, but makes it clear that she is in charge. Brenda accepts CJ’s offer, and Gershwin is eventually allowed to visit Veronique.

videos.title: Episode 263
videos.overview: Debbie-Lee calls Hermien after Tjoppie is arrested in France, and Shireen asks Edmund to go and assist Debbie-Lee. Gershwin gathers information on what exactly happened before Veronique’s fall. Joey and Nenna have to call in for help when Javin struggles with this maths homework.

videos.title: Episode 264
videos.overview: Gershwin discovers an interesting fact at the site of Veronique’s accident. CJ opens his heart towards Brenda, while Shireen has advice for Brenda concerning CJ. Octavia is livid when she finds out what happened to Junior - and that everyone knew about it. Shireen and Javin start a friendship, while Sandy has a warning for Nenna concerning Javin.

videos.title: Episode 265
videos.overview: Gershwin makes Veronique a promise - and manipulates Brenda into letting the cat ouf of the bag. Rachel offers Octavia a job to get her to forget about her revenge plans, and tries to carve out a new future for CJ. Javin feels guilty because he is enjoying life without his mother.

videos.title: Episode 266
videos.overview: Rachel’s attitude unnerves the workers, while there is suddenly tension in the Syster household because of a letter. Gershwin’s discovery of a document makes it very clear that Octavia and Hermien are actively trying to hide Marco’s dark deeds. Octavia is eager to show why she is the right candidate for the task at hand.

videos.title: Episode 267
videos.overview: Octavia thinks Rachel should give CJ her job, while CJ has other plans. Rachel makes it clear that she is the boss on the farm, and everyone has a turn to get burnt. CJ’s kiss doesn’t go down as well as he has hoped. Joey assists Javin with a difficult letter, and Gershwin starts to make friends with Napoleon…

videos.title: Episode 268
videos.overview: Rachel makes her plans for Soebatskloof known to everyone. Gershwin uses the information at hand to push CJ into a corner, while Brenda asks CJ for time so that the dust can settle properly. Javin finds a purpose unexpectedly, and it unexpectedly also moves Shireen.

videos.title: Episode 269
videos.overview: Octavia is not at all impressed with Matthew James, while Nenna is less than impressed with Broer Koos who is taking her household over. Brenda doesn’t like Rachel’s task for CJ, but CJ surprises Brenda with his actions. Shireen reconsiders her future.

videos.title: Episode 270
videos.overview: CJ has an idea on how to impress Rachel, but then Napoleon manages to destroy it. Matthew’s slyness with Octavia makes Sandy an instant fan, but then there is a dangerous side to him when he tinkers with wine. Nenna and Broer Koos don’t see eye to eye.

videos.title: Episode 271
videos.overview: Tensions are running high on Soebatskloof as Napoleon can’t remember anything about the previous day. Shireen reconsiders her career choices. Rachel puts CJ in an impossible position. Broer Koos’s past is catching up with him, and Joey and Dominee strong-arm Nenna into letting him stay a bit longer. Matthew and CJ meet each other – and Matthew learns that CJ is Junior’s only heir.

videos.title: Episode 272
videos.overview: Rachel gives Gershwin Napoleon’s job after Gershwin promises to be her eyes and ears on the farm. CJ doesn’t want to do Rachel’s bidding, but Gershwin manipulates him with a warning about Rachel. More and more people need Shireen’s help with medical things, and Rachel asks Matthew to stop antagonising Octavia. Broer Koos is chased away by Stil Piet.

videos.title: Episode 273
videos.overview: Gershwin lies and manipulates to silently move into a position of power - to Napoleon’s detriment. Shireen makes another headmove regarding her career. Octavia is not at all impressed with Matthew’s choices – or what he is allowed to do! Broer Koos manipulates Nenna into making him something, and Rachel shares very sensitive information with Octavia and CJ.

videos.title: Episode 274
videos.overview: Broer Koos manipulates Javin into a sly business plan. CJ is thrown in the deep end when the workers start confronting him about their service contracts. Octavia tries to get to know Matthew, but he is not interested. When Rachel is confronted by the reality of the farm and its people, Gershwin is the one that makes himself the answer. Shireen starts making changes to her house so that she will be able to help people…

videos.title: Episode 275
videos.overview: Octavia thinks she knows what is going on when Rachel tells her that Junior might never return - and that Matthew needs a stable environment to put down roots. She warns CJ, but CJ doesn’t want to know anything. Sandy moves into Joey’s house, as she no longer wants to sleep on the couch. Gershwin initiates his plan to dominate Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 276
videos.overview: Rachel tells Matthew what her plan is. Rachel’s plans for Soebatskloof kitchen are a headache for CJ, while Shireen’s dining room turns into a waiting room. Brenda and Gershwin tries to explain to CJ wat Matthew’s existence could mean for his inheritance, and CJ insults Matthew’s capabilities.

videos.title: Episode 277
videos.overview: Rachel’s big relaunch plans send shockwaves through the kitchen, while the possibility of a professional chef threatens to overthrow loyalties – especially for Brenda. Matthew makes it very clear that he wants the farm. Just when hope seems to be coming back with the opening of Shireen’s practise, an unexpected meeting might make deeper secrets come to the forefront.

videos.title: Episode 278
videos.overview: Shireen realises that she had every right to be concerned about Chantelle, while Tjoppie returns to Soebatskloof – but he is not himself. Broer Koos has an idea that he presents to Rachel and Octavia. CJ wants to change Rachel’s plans, but to do be able to do it he and Brenda will have to come up with a brand-new menu that will knock Rachel’s socks off – otherwise his cottage is not the only thing that he will have to distance himself from.

videos.title: Episode 279
videos.overview: Shireen realises that she had every right to be concerned about Chantelle, while Tjoppie returns to Soebatskloof – but he is not himself. Broer Koos has an idea that he presents to Rachel and Octavia. CJ wants to change Rachel’s plans, but to do be able to do it he and Brenda will have to come up with a brand-new menu that will knock Rachel’s socks off – otherwise his cottage is not the only thing that he will have to distance himself from.

videos.title: Episode 280
videos.overview: While Brenda and CJ are moving closer, a comment from CJ causes conflict between the brothers. Rachel’s plans for Soebatskloof threatens to throw the kitchen into disarray, while Shireen is at the start of a new chapter in her life.

videos.title: Episode 281
videos.overview: Rachel’s big relaunch plans sends shockwaves through the kitchen, while the possibility of a professional chef joining the team tests loyalty – especially that of Brenda. Shireen’s new glimmer of hope is put to the test when an unexpected reintroduction might lift the vail on deeper secrets of the past.

videos.title: Episode 282
videos.overview: Matthew starts liking life on Soebatskloof, while Broer Koos finds an unexpected ally. Shireen realises that she has reason to be concerned about Chantelle. Gershwin relays information to CJ which motivates him to make a bet with Rachel concerning the future of the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 283
videos.overview: Sandy’s unmotivated attitude regarding the big task at hand leaves Brenda with no other choice than to take a drastic step. Shireen’s concern regarding Chanelle grows - even more so when she faints in the practice. Matthew steals wine for Broer Koos, while Gershwin moves into another house on the farm.

videos.title: Episode 284
videos.overview: Sandy struggles to keep her head above water, and CJ is the one to give her insight in what she is supposed to do - and not just in the kitchen. Matthew uses sly tactics to get Rachel and Koos in the same room for a wine slushie. Shireen treats Chantelle’s wounds, but it is very clear that Shireen is not going to get the answers that she is looking for.

videos.title: Episode 285
videos.overview: CJ’s endeavour to support Brenda and Sandy takes a turn when Rachel makes impossible demands. Shireen gives Chantelle work to help her get back on her feet, and Broer Koos steels flowers for a woman.

videos.title: Episode 286
videos.overview: Chantelle struggles to find her feet in Shireen’s practise, and she walks out after an incident with a patient. Sandy’s anger regarding Rachel’s demands leads to a negotiation. Rachel and Matthew are starting to dream big, while Joey takes Koos on regarding his behaviour towards women. Broer Koos has a brand-new idea that he discusses with Matthew.

videos.title: Episode 287
videos.overview: Broer Koos’s "papsak" is a huge hit amongst the farm’s workers, but it leads to chaos. Shireen is concerned about Chantelle, but Nenna is worried about Shireen. Brenda and Sandy’s menu preparations aren't going according to plan. CJ’s news doesn't make things any easier for Brenda and Sandy.

videos.title: Episode 288
videos.overview: Rachel is not impressed with the workers or Broer Koos - and everyone gets a warning. Brenda and Sandy are unsure about how to approach food critic Pierre de Ryners, and Gershwin gets the number of his old restaurant. Shireen’s attempt at helping Chantelle is not going well - and not just because Chantelle takes a nap in the middle of the day.

videos.title: Episode 289
videos.overview: Rachel and Octavia are surprised when Hermien and Jan are back - without Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee. Hermien is shocked to find out who Matthew is, while she and Jan do not say anything about what is going on. Broer Koos gets very good news, while Gershwin gets blackmail material that could be used. Chantelle pleads with Shireen for a second chance, while Nenna gives her a warning.

videos.title: Episode 290
videos.overview: Hermien is caught off guard by Rachel’s plans for the farm. Brenda and Sandy have to make a decision regarding the photo that could be used to give them a win. Shireen’s loyalty is put to the test again: is it Chantelle, Nenna, or herself that succeeds? Octavia realizes that Broer Koos has a nose for the wine business.

videos.title: Episode 291
videos.overview: Hermien takes a stand against Rachel and the name change. Brenda gets a gamechanger idea that could help her and Sandy with the menu. A community’s recognition causes major jealousy, and Broer Koos is completely loved up.

videos.title: Episode 292
videos.overview: Broer Koos, egged on by Matthew, tries a new tactic in his pursuit of Octavia’s heart. Chantelle plays dirty when she makes Shireen question whether she truly deserves the recognition from the community. Brenda and Sandy have to overcome one more obstacle, and Rachel lets them know that if they fail to impress Pierre with the menu, Sandy will lose her job. CJ is caught off guard by a very upsetting remark by Matthew.

videos.title: Episode 293
videos.overview: The day is here for Pierre de Ryners to make his judgement on the menu. CJ talks to Octavia when his suspicion starts growing by the day regarding Matthew and Soebatskloof. Is there an unexpected kiss that might happen? There is an accident at Shireen’s practice, and she needs to urgently order medicine.

videos.title: Episode 294
videos.overview: Rachel is elated when Matthew makes an important decision regarding his future on Soebatskloof. Pierre’s decision will be discussed on his blog the following day. Chantelle’s guilty feelings lead to a very unpleasant outburst - and then she hides something from Shireen. Broer Koos is down and out when Octavia shows him the door.

videos.title: Episode 295
videos.overview: Brena wonders whether or not to use the blackmail material when Pierre’s food review is published. Shireen confronts a dangerous situation that could place her own life at risk. Rachel shares the "good" news about Matthew with Hermien - but then she receives a mysterious call. Perfume leads to a secret meeting, where two hearts might just become one.

videos.title: Episode 296
videos.overview: Rachel orchestrates a high-risk relaunch that tests Sandy and Brenda to the outmost. Octavia makes it very clear to Broer Koos that he may not tell a soul about what is going on between them, and then Suné calls. Shireen’s fear drives her to do something very unethical - and she's shocked in what she finds. Rachel shares news with Hermien.

videos.title: Episode 297
videos.overview: The restaurant rushes to get everything done when it is booked out for 10 days. Javin makes a discovery and runs straight to Nenna to tell her. Shireen can’t concentrate on her work; she is still stunned after the HIV-test. Rachel tells Matthew about the new opportunity, and it forces him to make another huge decision. CJ is not impressed wit the fact that Matthew and Brenda are working very well together.

videos.title: Episode 298
videos.overview: CJ gets an unpleasant surprise when Rachel leaves for London. Nenna gives Broer Koos advice on his new love. Shireen tells Nenna what happened, and Linda overhears Chantelle franticly looking for a new place to stay.

videos.title: Episode 299
videos.overview: Veronique wakes up from the coma - but there is clearly something wrong. Octavia still wants to keep her relationship with Broer Koos a secret, but Broer Koos puts his foot down: now that the Systers know, everyone should know! CJ feels uncomfortable when he sees that Brenda enjoys Matthew in the kitchen. Shireen confronts Chantelle, and Chantelle realises what Shireen has done.

videos.title: Episode 300
videos.overview: Veronique struggles with the lost time and Gershwin is ready to take what he has always wanted. Octavia introduces Broer Koos to her family, and Broer Koos is very emotional when he is welcomed with open arms - but then his relationship is threatened by a ghost from his past. Shireen is confronted with the consequences of her decision.

videos.title: Episode 301
videos.overview: Shireen’s world starts imploding again when she has to explain to her family what happened – and what Chantelle is planning on doing. Broer Koos opens his heart up to Matthew, and greets Octavia without her knowing. Veronique is frustrated with her memories - especially when her wedding ring doesn’t mean anything to her. Matthew starts seeing Brenda in a different light.

videos.title: Episode 302
videos.overview: Octavia finds out that Broer Koos has left via second-hand knowledge, but at least has a letter to try and save her heart. Gershwin lets Brenda know that Veronique is awake, but designs a new timeline that will curb Veronique’s questions concerning the past. Nenna can’t help confronting Chantelle, while Joey isn’t pleased when he finds out that Nenna knows more than he does. Shireen makes a heartbreaking decision.

videos.title: Episode 303
videos.overview: CJ’s jealousy towards Matthew and Brenda reaches breaking point: when he confronts Brenda on her working relationship with Matthew, she decides to sleep over at Gershwin’s house. Suné, Broer Koos’s ex-fiancé, arrives on Soebatskloof: when she can’t find Broer Koos, Joey takes her to Octavia. Veronique tells nurse Erin that her name is Dawn - and Erin’s uncomfortable questions makes Gershwin uneasy.

videos.title: Episode 304
videos.overview: CJ’s jealousy drives a wedge between him and Brenda, and when he goes to apologise it leads to Brenda making a drastic decision. Octavia struggles to process Broer Koos’s betrayal, and gets angry about the situation when she discusses it with Hermien. Gershwin manipulates Erin to say nothing about what she heard, and he lets Veronique unknowingly sign very important documents.

videos.title: Episode 305
videos.overview: Octavia is still struggling to process Broer Koos's exit, but then Matthew gives her new insight on who he really is. Brenda wants to move out of the cottage, but CJ has a better plan. Erin is caught out when she wants to warn Veronique against Gershwin. Gershwin realises he will have to speed up his plans to get her out of the facility. Shireen shares good news with Javin.

videos.title: Episode 306
videos.overview: Things are uncomfortable in the cottage when Brenda has no other choice but to go along with Gershwin’s plan. Veronique feels disorientated and doesn’t know the adult version of Brenda. A stranger rocks up at Soebatskloof, and when Hermien begins to ask questions, the stranger insists on Jan answereing them. As Veronique makes herself at home at the cottage, Brenda's suspicions about Gershwin's true intentions grow. The friendship between Brenda and Matthew is steering towards a disaster, and Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie are back.

videos.title: Episode 307
videos.overview: Tjoppie wants to make contact with his sons again, and surprises CJ. CJ also has a surprise for his father. Jan has a lot of explaining to do towards Hermien, but also makes a few startling revelations that lets Hermien look at their marriage in a new light. Veronique has questions for Brenda when Gershwin promises to lock her away if she doesn’t stop wandering around the farm. Brenda’s new ideas for the menu gives Matthew other ideas…

videos.title: Episode 308
videos.overview: Tjoppie and Marco see each other again for the first time and give a few steps in the direction of where they were before. CJ is still brooding over Matthew, and Octavia warns him against it. Things are tense between Gershwin and Veronique, when Veronique wants to see her sons – and then it becomes even more tense when she discovers a marriage certificate. Lida eventually tells Hermien and Jan why she has come to visit Soebatskloof.

videos.title: Episode 309
videos.overview: Lida asks Jan to complete the bucket list they compiled. Sandy and Brenda are livid when Matthew doesn’t show up for work, and when Brenda confronts him it becomes clear that that is not the real issue for the explosive discussion. Veronique discovers some harsh truths, and some pretty uncomfortable ones, about her past on the internet – and then asks Gershwin about Allistair’s death.

videos.title: Episode 310
videos.overview: Hermien faces an impossible choice while Jan's loyalty is tested by a ghost from his past. Tjoppie and Debbie-Lee struggle with the harsh reality that stands between them and healing. CJ and Matthew reach breaking point down in the cellar, and Gershwin and Veronique disappear - destination unsure, motives unclear...

videos.title: Episode 311
videos.overview: Despite knowing that his decision will hurt Hermien, Jan refuses to change his mind. Octavia confronts Hermien when she finds out that Tjoppie is back on Soebatskloof. Tjoppie asks for a family meeting, and Marco clears his heart - and conscience. Matthew and Brenda’s passionate fighting leads to a remarkable moment in time.

videos.title: Episode 312
videos.overview: The Marais family decide to have a huge braai on Soebatskloof to lift everyone’s spirits. Tjoppie shares a secret with CJ and Marco. Brenda and Matthew are awkward with each other after their kiss. Brenda has no idea how to control her emotions. Phillip and Nenna both get a feeling that something is going to go wrong - and a big dark cloud hangs over Soebatskloof.
